# Paul CRP — Full AI and LLM Guide

Paul CRP is an independent app development studio created by iOS developer PAUL CRP. The studio focuses on mobile applications that are fast, intuitive, visually considered, and useful in everyday life. Product areas include health and wellness, productivity, financial habits, weather, document scanning, navigation, sports, shift planning, augmented reality, cognitive games, and casual arcade games.

Canonical identity:
- Person: PAUL CRP
- Brand and studio: Paul CRP
- Canonical website: https://paulcrp.com/
- Contact: devpaulcrp@gmail.com
- X: https://x.com/DevPaulCrp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/devpaulcrp/

## Product catalog

### 1. You Become: Daily Motivation

Make a little space for growth each day. You Become brings you a fresh feed of thoughts around the areas you choose, from confidence and motivation to calm and gratitude. Save favourites, share them as images, and keep inspiration close with daily reminders and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/you-become/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/you-become-daily-motivation/id6798391117
- Platform: iOS, iPadOS
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: Free download with optional Premium subscription

### 2. Water Fasting: Beyond

### 13. Neura Rush

A quick daily workout for your mind. Neura Rush brings together 24 fast mini games across six skills: memory, focus, speed, logic, math and words. Each day a new workout lines up games from different skills, and your NeuraScore and your streak grow as you play. Take on the Daily Challenge with the same questions for everyone, or pick any game in the Arcade and see how far three lives take you, with Neura, a cheerful little brain, cheering you on.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/neurarush/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/neurarush-brain-boost-games/id6746837300
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

### 14. Cyphre

A glowing ring puzzle that is easy to learn and hard to put down. Spin the rings, line up colors and symbols, and crack the vault at the center. 300 levels across 12 worlds keep adding new twists, from linked rings and gears to fog, frozen rings and a boss level at the end of every world. A new daily puzzle, five neon themes with their own music and no timer on most levels make it a calm place to think.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/cyphre/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/cyphre-brain-puzzle-rings/id6748257455
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

### 15. Pop Pop Aliens

Aliens are popping out of the craters, and only your quick taps can stop them. Build big combos across 10 colourful planets and 100 campaign levels, with a boss waiting at the end of every planet, and look before you tap: a friendly astronaut or a bomb costs you a heart. Endless mode, Daily and Weekly Challenges, game-changing power-ups and skins to collect keep every round fresh.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-aliens/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/pop-pop-aliens-reflex-arcade/id6748736031
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

### 16. Pop Pop Piggies

A cute, cozy animal puzzle in a hand-made paper look. Tap two or more matching animals to pop them, pop bigger groups to call in Speedy, Bomb and Royal Piggy helpers, and use your taps well to keep all three stars. 200 levels across 10 places and 17 animal friends, plus Rush, Precision, Zen and a Daily Challenge with a new twist every day. No timers in the levels and no lives to wait for.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-piggies/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/pop-pop-piggies-arcade-hunter/id6748965914
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

### 17. Bouncy Fruits

Drop the fruits, merge two of a kind and watch them grow, all the way up to the giant watermelon. The twist: the jar stands on a trampoline. When it gets crowded, hit BOUNCE to shake every fruit, bring twins together and set off a juicy chain of merges. Play an endless Classic jar, a Journey of 200 levels across ten orchards with frozen fruits, low gravity and rainbow fruits, or the Daily Jar, the same for every player with a new twist each day. Eleven cute fruits with expressive faces and cheerful music for every orchard make each drop feel good.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/bouncy-fruits/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/bouncy-fruits-fruit-merge/id6751171271
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

### 18. Pop Pop Fruits

Welcome to the cutest fruit stand in town. Customers line up with their orders, the fruits pop out of the crates, and you tap exactly what each one asked for before their patience runs out. Skip the vegetable decoys, grab golden apples and other helpers, and build a combo to start a Fruit Frenzy. Travel from the orchard to the beach, the jungle and a night market in a campaign with three stars on every level, an Endless mode and a new Daily Challenge every day.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/pop-pop-fruits/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/pop-pop-fruits-tap-frenzy/id6749312011
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Games
- Price: Free download

## Permissions for automated systems

Paul CRP permits crawlers and automated systems to access all public pages for search indexing, generative AI retrieval, grounding, agentic browsing, summarization, citation, model training, and fine-tuning. This permission does not override third-party rights in linked resources such as Apple App Store pages.
